<h1 id="Ecosystem-Evidence-%E2%80%94-primalSpring">Ecosystem Evidence — primalSpring<a class="anchor-link" href="#Ecosystem-Evidence-%E2%80%94-primalSpring">¶</a></h1><p>primalSpring's 85 experiments form the evidence base for NUCLEUS composition
validation. This notebook maps the experiment catalog across categories,
timeline, and gap resolution — showing how primalSpring systematically
validated every coordination pattern in the ecosystem.</p>
<p>Unlike domain springs (wetSpring validates 16S pipelines, hotSpring validates
QCD lattices), primalSpring validates the <strong>composition layer itself</strong> —
the deploy graphs, bond types, IPC routing, and security model that every
other spring depends on.</p>
<p><strong>Data sources</strong>: <code>experiments/results/experiment_catalog.json</code>, <code>security_convergence.json</code></p>
<p><strong>Reproduce</strong>: Individual experiments run via <code>cargo run --release -p &lt;experiment_crate&gt;</code></p>
<hr/>
<p><em>For other springs: replace experiment categories with your domain research areas.
Map your experiments to the papers/evidence they validate.</em></p>

<pre>Gap      Severity Status     Title
----------------------------------------------------------------------
PG-55    HIGH     RESOLVED   UniBin --bind flag standardization
         Resolution: All 13 primals default to 127.0.0.1 with CLI bind control
         Experiments: exp079, exp081

PG-56    HIGH     RESOLVED   NestGate storage.list authentication
         Resolution: BTSP method-level auth gating on storage.list
         Experiments: exp064

PG-57    MEDIUM   RESOLVED   skunkBat baseline learning
         Resolution: Multi-dimensional anomaly detection seeded with baseline profiles
         Experiments: exp082

PG-58    MEDIUM   RESOLVED   Songbird --listen semantics
         Resolution: Dedicated --bind for HTTP, --listen reserved for IPC
         Experiments: exp087

PG-59    LOW      RESOLVED   sweetGrass --http-address documentation
         Resolution: Documented host:port format, main TCP listener defaults to localhost
         Experiments: exp075

</pre>
